title: Enterprise LLM Fine-Tuning & Domain Adaptation Platform Selection Guide: Azure AI Foundry Managed Fine-Tuning vs. LLaMA-Factory / Axolotl + vLLM Multi-LoRA on AKS

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Full Fine-Tuning (16*Psi Memory) + 40 Dedicated Merged-Weight GPU Deployments
tiers.recommended_scenario: Severe anti-pattern: 40 siloed merged-weight deployments cause 10x GPU sprawl

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Cloud Managed Fine-Tuning with 40 Dedicated Hourly Hosted Endpoints
tiers.recommended_scenario: Hourly per-endpoint hosting fees dominate TCO when many low-traffic adapters exist

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Azure AI Foundry Global/Serverless Fine-Tuning (Pay-per-Token Multi-LoRA Hosting, Zero Idle Hourly Fee)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Optimal for <=15 adapters or proprietary GPT-4o/4o-mini fine-tuning with zero K8s ops

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Off-Peak Tidal AKS Training (LLaMA-Factory / Axolotl Multipack + Liger) + vLLM Multi-LoRA Serving
tiers.recommended_scenario: Enterprise AI factory standard consolidating 40 adapters onto 8 H200 GPUs (-94.4% monthly TCO)
